chunks: And ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd narrated from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Amir al-Muʾminin عليه السلام said: “A man and a woman are not to be flogged until four witnesses testify against them regarding penetration and withdrawal.”
And he said: “I would not be the first of the four witnesses, for I fear the fright that one of them may shrink back, and then I would be flogged.”

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةُ شُهُودٍ: four witnesses required to establish the legal proof
key_terms.أَوَّلَ الشُّهُودِ الْأَرْبَعَةِ: the first among the four witnesses in a legally consequential testimony
key_terms.الْإِيلَاجِ وَ الْإِخْرَاجِ: explicit penetration and withdrawal, the precise act that must be witnessed
key_terms.يَنْكُلَ: to shrink back or refuse to proceed with testimony
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: to be flogged with the prescribed legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What proof is required before a man or woman can be flogged for zina in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states the strict evidentiary requirement for establishing the hadd punishment in a zina case: four witnesses must testify explicitly to the act itself. It also conveys the gravity of such testimony, since if the witnesses fail to complete the legal standard, they themselves may face punishment for false accusation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4991 - Aṣim ibn Humayd narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"The Commander of the Faithful (as) said: "A man or a woman shall not be flogged until four witnesses testify explicitly to the act of penetration and withdrawal."
Imam (as) also said: "I will not be the first among the four witnesses because I fear that one of them might retract their testimony, and I would then be subjected to flogging."
